text:
oliver: Kicking off the monthly recurrence-pattern review. Scan attached shows top recurring signatures: sig-tilt, sig-edge, sig-leak, sig-spike, sig-timeout. This thread to lock remediation owners, realistic ETAs, and ACs.

priya: I can take sig-tilt and sig-leak. Sig-tilt needs a kernel backport (PR K-7812) so ETA depends on infra.

sam: I'll own sig-edge short-term mitigation (rate-limiter + variant pin). ETA for short-term: 5 business days; long-term redesign 6w.

kate: I'll pick up sig-spike and monitoring changes for sig-timeout. Will add runbook updates and alert thresholds.

incident-bot: Auto-scan: run=2026-05-07; total recurrences=24; signatures=[sig-tilt,sig-edge,sig-leak,sig-spike,sig-timeout]; created followups: PM-1407..PM-1409. Template: owner | ticket | ETA | AC | fallback.

oliver: Please update tracker row: <https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/INC-TRACKER-RECURRENCE>. Use conservative ETAs (include approval windows).

priya: For sig-leak quick mitigation I tested prefix cache eviction and mem-quantization in staging (commands below).

```
# invalidate prefix cache
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/cache/invalidate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prefix":"/models/tilt/"}'
# enable mem-quant for pool
rgctl pools update --name pool-tilt --quant mem
```

priya: Staging smoke 6h -> 0 recurrences. Will run 24h and post results.

sam: Sig-edge short-term mitigation in staging: pinned model variant and lowered router batch size.

```
rgctl models pin --model edge-v2
rgctl routes update --route edge-router --batch-size 12
```

sam: Smoke 3h stable. I'll post 24h logs tonight.

kate: For sig-timeout I adjusted alert thresholds and added a 5m suppression window during deploys. AC for sig-timeout: "<3 timeouts/day and 99th percentile latency <400ms for 14d".

oliver: Who will own weekly follow-ups? Need a single thread owner to post status and escalate blockers.

priya: I'll update tracker and post weekly status. If infra blocks K-7812 beyond Tue EOD, I'll mark as blocked and switch to fallback.

infra-bot: K-7812 review requested by @priya. Infra ETA 72h for kernel backport assessment. See CAP-9522 for capacity implications.

sam: Long-term for sig-edge: redesign the router to be shard-aware. Kate, can you help with monitoring queries for regressions?

kate: Sure. Proposed monitoring query for sig-edge recurrence detection: `sum(increase(request_errors_total{sig="sig-edge"}[1d])) > 2`. Will add dashboard tile.

priya: Fallback for sig-tilt if backport delayed: enable user-level throttling + conservative batch-size (latency hit ~7-12%). Documented in tracker.

oliver: Acceptance criteria examples: "no more than 2 recurrences in 30d" and automated alerting to sev2 only. All ACs must include monitoring query and rollback plan.

incident-bot: Reminder: follow-ups must include owner, ticket, ETA, AC, monitoring query, and fallback. Use template in tracker row.

sam: I'll draft the sig-edge long-term design doc and link it in the tracker by EOD Friday.

kate: I've started alert runbooks and will add the suppression window details. Also adding PD rotation to the tracker row.

priya: If infra approves K-7812, ETA for sig-tilt P1 fix is 3w; if denied, fallback path extends ETA to 5w. I'll add both estimates.

oliver: Great. Next steps: owners update tracker by EOD tomorrow, infra to respond to K-7812 in 72h, sam to post 24h staging logs, priya to post 24h staging logs. Weekly status on Fridays by owner. If blockers remain after 72h, we'll escalate in ops huddle.

incident-bot: Closing note: tracker is source of truth; post updates there and tag @ops when you hit blockers.

priya: Thanks all. I'm adding ACs and monitoring queries to each tracker row now.
